outputs.discrepancies: Caption states that MitoTracker Deep Red accumulation in Atxn1(86Q)-DsRed-transfected cells 'was reduced by co-expression of HMGB1-GFP,' implying HMGB1-GFP further lowers the mitochondrial dye signal. However, the images show the opposite pattern: the Atxn1-86Q-DsRed column (without HMGB1-GFP) has visibly reduced/punctate MitoTracker Deep Red signal compared to the Empty-DsRed control, while the Atxn1-86Q-DsRed;HMGB1-GFP column shows restored/stronger MitoTracker Deep Red staining, consistent with HMGB1 rescuing (not reducing) the mitochondrial membrane potential defect. The caption wording therefore contradicts what is visually depicted, even though it matches the figure title ('HMGB1 restores mitochondrial functions').
